comparison.objective: Candidate installs rack hardware; record buckles and positions a restraint harness around a doll.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate handles a rigid articulated rail and mechanical fasteners; record routes flexible webbing, inserts buckle tongues, closes a chest clip, and adjusts harness placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks structural engagement and screw-hole use; record checks tongues, clip position, release, stillness, seat motion, and head clearance.
comparison.reason: Different objective, material behavior, and manipulation capability. Candidate missing numeric tolerances do not create plausible overlap.
